clips.title: The story
paras: Red banners mark the Military Ward, where Ironforge's defenders gather and train. Its command halls, weapons masters, barracks, siege engines, and flying machines serve the mountain city's military.

The Military Ward gathers Ironforge's defenses in a busy staging ground along the northern edge of the mountain fortress. At its center, the Hall of Arms holds warrior and hunter trainers and battlemasters, with hangars for dwarven flying machines and steam tanks. Around the drill squares and training dummies, supply shops include Craghelm's Plate and Chain, Goldfury's Hunting Supplies, and Timberline Arms. The ward is Ironforge's main staging point for mountaineers and city defenders.

Red banners cover the Military Ward, setting it apart from the Commons' pale blue and the Great Forge's fiery orange. Between drills and weapons inspections, soldiers and off-duty guards gather for ale at Bruuk's Corner. Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand teaches recruits the ancient martial traditions of the dwarves.
